# LMIA Watch

> Public records of Canada's Labour Market Impact Assessments (LMIAs): which
> employers applied to hire temporary foreign workers, where, and which were
> approved or refused, with the Job Bank postings that carry an LMIA flag.
> Updated nightly from Employment and Social Development Canada and Job Bank.
> In English and French (?lang=fr). https://lmiawatch.ca

## Bulk data: read these instead of crawling 160,000 profile pages

Everything the profile pages show is in these files, refreshed every night.
They hold more than the pages do and cost far less to read.

- https://lmiawatch.ca/downloads/employers.csv: one row per employer with a profile
- https://lmiawatch.ca/downloads/approved_quarterly.csv: every positive LMIA row from ESDC's quarterly lists since 2014
- https://lmiawatch.ca/downloads/refused_quarterly.csv: every negative LMIA row
- https://lmiawatch.ca/downloads/pending_observations.csv: every nightly observation of a Job Bank posting with an LMIA flag
- https://lmiawatch.ca/downloads/indicators.csv: the indicator rows the profiles show
- https://lmiawatch.ca/downloads/esdc_resources.csv: the ESDC files each row came from
- https://lmiawatch.ca/data: what each file holds, its licence, and the ESDC source files mirrored unchanged
- https://lmiawatch.ca/cite: the Zenodo deposit (one version per ESDC quarter, with a DOI) and citation formats

Downloads are limited to ten per minute per address. The JSON API is not open
to outside callers; use the files.

## Pages worth reading

- https://lmiawatch.ca/methodology: how records are matched, graded and limited
- https://lmiawatch.ca/international: Job Bank postings open to international candidates, graded for the Express Entry job-offer path, and the designated-employer lists
- https://lmiawatch.ca/notices: government notices that touch these programs
- https://lmiawatch.ca/corrections: how to report an error

## Terms

The records are reproduced under the Open Government Licence (Canada) and the
provincial licences named on https://lmiawatch.ca/data. Figures the site
computes are adapted from those sources. A record is a record, never a finding
about an employer.
